method: System.IO.Compression.ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory into a new explicitly named directory, then exact relative-member set and SHA256 equality of every source and decompressed member; no overwrite/deletion/extraction.
contains: Private frozen materials, exact prompts/token IDs, all raw responses/HTTP and memory journals, source snapshots, claim, official template and private analysis.
privacy: Archive stays outside Git and must not be publicly redistributed. No protected review map was accessed or recopied; earlier preserved review package remains unchanged.
limitation: Same-volume preservation protects against accidental source edits, not disk loss or site loss. Model weights and original corpus are separate assets.
